methodology.labels: Assistant-reviewed originals and source XML/PDF annotations; not blinded or independently adjudicated. Frozen machine outputs scored before corrections.
methodology.normalization: NFKC, whitespace and trailing label colon. Phone punctuation ignored. URL http(s), www prefix and trailing slash ignored. No synonym expansion.
methodology.matching: Non-null exact scalar claims, with entry ordinal for jobs, education and projects. Wrong value = one FP plus one FN. Null/null is not counted. Skills matched as (category, full source phrase), keeping parentheses and ampersand phrases intact.
methodology.scope: Contact, job identity/location/dates/bullet counts, education identity/location/dates/GPA, project identity/dates/bullet counts/explicit technology lists, certification record labels and explicit skill groups. Headings measured separately. Not every prose assertion or award/publication metadata field is scored.
